title: 2521: Introduce leaflet-dialog, to show story of timeline

comments_data.body:
Thanks @philb89 

>  I will need an example of how to set the content.

Could you also add a prop for the content?  As a demo of how to `drive` the content of the dialog panel, I'd like it to show the contents of the right-click array, as demonstrated here:
https://github.com/serge-web/serge/pull/2543/commits/d883005e83b01d9b3ab6bf2cc69d7775630c7c91

So, once you've added the new prop - we'll be able to call `setReplayDialogContent` - a state setter which will update the content of the dialog.

Hello @lebaphi  - there is a bit more work to do this too, please:
https://github.com/serge-web/serge/pull/2543#issuecomment-1453769049

issues.title: Introduce leaflet-dialog, to show story of timeline
issues.body:
Here is a react wrapper for a popup dialog:
https://github.com/mhasbie/react-leaflet-dialog

I'd like us to integrate it into the planning channel.  It will be visible when `showTimeControl` is true.  I will need an example of how to set the content.

Initially, I'd like it to be in the bottom-left of the map, about 300px wide and high.
